test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 6: COURSE LIFECYCLE (COURSE DELETION) - Phase 2: Test Course Deletion Process
test_cases.test_case_title: Attempt Course Deletion Without Enabling 'Allow Deletion' Checkbox
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with a pre-provisioned account is logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page. A course named 'Temporary Course for Deletion' exists and the Teacher has opened its 'Modify Course' modal.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Delete' button in the 'Modify Course' modal should be disabled or have no effect when clicked, as the 'Allow Deletion' checkbox is not ticked.
test_cases.post_condition: The 'Modify Course' modal remains open, displaying the course details for 'Temporary Course for Deletion', and the course is not deleted from the system. The 'Delete' button remains disabled.

test_steps.step: Log in with GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com and ValidPassword123!Giangteacher.
Click the 'Edit' button next to the course 'Temporary Course for Deletion'.
Attempt to click the 'Delete' button in the 'Modify Course' modal without ticking the 'Allow Deletion' checkbox.
